entries.title: Isaiah 4:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 In the extremity of evils, Christ's kingdom shall be a sanctuary.

And in. 2:11,17; 10:20; 17:7; Lu 21:22 seven. 3:25,26; 13:12 We will eat. 2Th 3:12 let us be called by thy name. Heb. let thy name be calledupon us. to take away. or, take thou away. reproach. Ge 30:23; 1Sa 1:6; Lu 1:25

entries.title: Isaiah 4:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the branch. 11:1; 60:21; Jer 23:5; 33:15; Eze 17:22,23; Zec 3:8; 6:12 beautiful and glorious. Heb. beauty and glory. Ex 28:2; Zec 9:17; Joh 1:14; 2Co 4:6; 2Pe 1:16 the fruit. 27:6; 30:23; 45:8; Ps 67:6; 85:11,12; Ho 2:22,23; Joe 3:18 them that are escaped. Heb. the escaping. 10:20-22; 27:12,13; 37:31,32; Jer 44:14,28; Eze 7:16; Joe 2:32 Ob 1:17; Mt 24:22; Lu 21:36; Ro 11:4,5; Re 7:9-14
